items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-10-14
items.q: You were telling us outside that you were in the Navy with George Williams.

ctx.x: Good musician and headman, just like Mani Parade. Good musician and headman.
You might tell us a little bit about the Claiborne Williams band. You were telling us outside that you were in the Navy with George Williams. With George Williams.

Very, very first class musician. And he's back in, up in Baton Rouge. He's teaching, yeah. My wife teaches school. I think he's teaching music at some school, I think. I'm not sure, but I don't know. He's also selling instruments and everything. Yeah. We played, he was standing on the corner of Jackson Avenue. The last time we played that big parade, we left him, Drys and Phillip. We had four or five bands out.
